description: This file defines a report for KSA VAT calculations in an ERP system, including functions to gather and process VAT data for sales and purchases, and generate report data with totals.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the VAT report table.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles VAT data for sales and purchases based on filters.

methods.name: get_tax_data_for_each_vat_setting
methods.description: Calculates total taxable amounts, adjustments, and taxes for each VAT setting and invoice type.

methods.name: append_data
methods.description: Appends a row of data to the report dataset.

methods.name: get_tax_amount
methods.description: Calculates tax amount for an item based on tax details in the document.
